It shows that low Al content (Al0.1) fails to form detectable Al2O3, which actually contradicts the premise that ~2 at.% Al would form a protective alumina scale in this different alloy system. No evidence is provided for the other key premises regarding scale continuity, diffusion barrier effectiveness, or preservation of mechanical properties in HfNbTaTiZr.
